caption: The drawing, rendered in black ink on a plain light beige background, depicts three distinct objects arranged vertically. Each object has a handle with ornamental detailing, featuring a design that appears to mimic organic or skeletal forms. The top object is a round-headed spoon with the bowl facing up, inscribed inside the bowl are the letters "O S" on either side of a cross, and the words "Short & Cressy, Aylsham" written along the curve, with decorative elements along the handle and the initials "PA" marked on the handle. The middle object is similar in overall form, but the spoon bowl is empty of all inscription or ornament and faces directly upward, with the handle including decorative reliefs but no letters. The bottom object, also with an ornamented handle, is a flat, curved utensil, drawn with the flat edge facing left and the handle to the right side; this handle also has intricate designs, similar to the others. In the bottom left corner of the page, the artist's signature "WATT. O.N.K." is present. The whole composition is monochrome, with all lines and details in dark ink against the light background.
title: Silver Funeral Spoon
